entities.title: Game scene
entities.summary: The main scene: SimHost with the space scene, the HUD, the tunnels and the panels around it, and every key routed to a press.
entities.purpose: game.tscn is the project's main scene. game.gd builds the rest around SimHost, routes one-shot keys by mode, screen and pause, holds the escape pod's one-second key, pauses on focus loss, and takes the command-line options for screenshots and scripted runs; script_runner.gd plays scripted games and the headless smoke test.
boundaries: Held flight actions are sampled by SimHost from the input map, not here.
The input map itself is in project.godot.
